agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Cistern is fat but not full — clear sky still sips the ditch, so top it before the growing row asks for another pour.
today.expect: Cistern at the brim so tomorrow's irrigate never competes with the gauge.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. The ear is in the bin and a new row is down — top the cistern before any clear-sky drip can write the ending.
yesterday.expect: Cistern fatter so tomorrow's irrigate and the sprout never threaten each other.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve — and the row is already growing under a full ditch. Heat does not wait; timber while the crop advances is the other compounding play.
today.expect: Wood pile thicker before the ear asks for hands again.

yesterday.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve — and this row just went in. Ditches compound. Heat does not wait. Push moisture onto the sprout while the ditch still multiplies every pour.
yesterday.expect: East field moisture near the top so the sprout advances under clear sky.
